build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with two balls and a bar containing a hole
create_dynamic_balls: create two dynamic balls positioned at specific coordinates within the PHYRE scene
add_static_bar_with_hole: add a static bar with a gap using two bar segments in the PHYRE scene
configure_spatial_relationship: configure the task to require ball1 touching ball2 as the spatial relationship goal
set_solution_tier: set the task solution tier to PRE_BALL for pre-ball interaction validation
